text.p: --Hambrecht and Quist analyst Joe Noel said he upgraded Verilink Corp to a buy from a hold, citing a resumption of its earlier strong revenue and earnings growth and the expectation the company will seal new contracts. He said the company "has been working to land several new contracts over the past several weeks" and recently entered some substantial contracts "that were not expected only three weeks ago."

--Noel did not expect the positive developments at Verilink to be reflected in the June quarter, but said he believes "it is highly possible that Verilink will be able to restore robust growth patterns by the September or December quarters."
--Verilink makes integrated access products for telecommunications network service providers and corporate end users.
